verdict.rationale: Docs confirm role-based permissions (owner, organizer, fileOrganizer, writer, commenter, reader) applied at file/folder level via the permissions resource, plus explicit inheritance behavior ('Access you apply to a folder is inherited by all files within it') and share settings controlling edit/comment/view access. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of inheritance edge cases (e.g. mixed permission overrides) and no dedicated admin-console documentation for org-wide inheritance policies.
